item.title: Treasure Beach is a scavenger game where you can sell what you find hidden in the sand to stingy shoppers—and let me warn you, it isn't easy
item.content:encoded: These shoppers are having me on.

item.title: Don't like the MacBook Neo's storage options? Well, with lots of electronics gear, years of experience, and nerves of steel, you too can have a 1 TB model
item.content:encoded: Shame you can't embiggen your own gaming SSDs like this. Or can you?

item.title: During a memory crisis do you really need fast memory for PC gaming? No, no you do not
item.content:encoded: Does fast DDR5 make a difference to gaming, you know what? It doesn't. Mostly.

item.title: Look, 16 GB of RAM is absolutely fine for PC gaming in 2026. Though there are some caveats to that...
item.content:encoded: If it's good enough for consoles, surely it's good enough for a gaming PC?

item.title: Mozilla says 'Microsoft goes too far' with Copilot, right before reassuring that you can turn off Firefox's 'AI enhancements'
item.content:encoded: Is AI integration really so inescapable?

item.title: Overwatch Sierra abilities and perks explained
item.content:encoded: Watchpoint: Grand Mesa’s Head of Security is here.

item.title: Keychron has shared the source files for all its keyboard and mice meaning you could almost build an entire kit from scratch
item.content:encoded: It even offers a license to sell homemade accessories you make.

item.title: WoW's next patch drops in just over a week, bringing a whole heap of world content and yet another gearing method from a deeply suspicious ally
item.content:encoded: I don't trust Decimus, but I like his energy.

item.title: Of course 1440p is your favorite gaming res, but I'm kinda stunned there are as many 4K gamers as 1080p ones in PC Gamer's ranks
item.content:encoded: Sure, 36% of you play at 2560 x 1440, but at 22% it's a straight tie between 4K and 1080p gamers in our latest poll.

item.title: Intel's fabs may at long last be worth all those billions of dollars
item.content:encoded: Its market capitalization is higher than it's ever been for over 25 years, thanks to recent chips and deals with Google and the Terafab project.

item.title: 'It stayed exactly the same': Jeff Kaplan takes us back to 2016 by confirming that Blizzard did not change the size of Tracer's butt
item.content:encoded: Now we're getting somewhere.

item.title: Microsoft is removing Copilot branding from Photos, Notepad, and more after promising to reduce 'unnecessary Copilot entry points'
item.content:encoded: It's better than nothing, I suppose.

item.title: Asus announces the ROG Equalizer: a new cable aimed at making melting GPU power connectors a thing of the past
item.content:encoded: It's even compatible with PSUs from other vendors, as long as it has a decent 12V-2x6 socket.

item.title: Former Bethesda artist says 'every single developer' has already brought up 95% of the complaints that made it to launch, but as Todd Howard told him, 'we can't do everything'
item.content:encoded: You can't win 'em all.

item.title: Framework: 'There is a very real scenario in which personal computing as we know it is dead'
item.content:encoded: The memory crisis may have a very lasting impact on the PC hardware industry.

item.title: Crimson Desert devs are addressing all your complaints (and then some) in a long list of planned updates, which includes adding difficulty options
item.content:encoded: That's a mighty fine list of planned changes.

item.title: CPUID's download page has been hacked, with its popular processor and PC info tools replaced with links to files containing malware
item.content:encoded: If you've recently downloaded CPU-Z or HWMonitor, do a full scan of your computer now.

item.title: The James Bond rights owners have opposed an application for a James Pond trademark
item.content:encoded: Licence to Eel. Octoguppy. I'm just brainstorming here.

item.title: The ill-advised business software that helped sink videogame pioneers Infocom now runs on modern PCs: 'It's a new age for aficionados of failed 1985 database products!'
item.content:encoded: The database app Cornerstone ended up being more of a cinderblock.

item.title: Nexon confirms reorganizaton at The First Berserker: Khazan developer but says it's merely 'a strategic reallocation of talent' as development winds down
item.content:encoded: The shuffle is "not a workforce reduction or team dissolution," Nexon says, it just needs the people elsewhere.

item.title: Darkstone, a classic 1999 action RPG about eating apples and trying not to die of old age, is being remastered by its original creator
item.content:encoded: Eat the apple, apple boy.

item.title: Nine-year-old cult visual novel Doki Doki Literature Club has been abruptly pulled from Android for its 'depiction of sensitive themes'
item.content:encoded: Doki Doki Literature Club released on Google Play in December.

item.title: Dune: Awakening is finally making Deep Desert and shipwreck PvP fully optional
item.content:encoded: Self-hosted servers are coming too.

item.title: 20 years after Kojima announced a Metal Gear Solid movie was happening, Sony announces a Metal Gear Solid movie is happening
item.content:encoded: But will it actually happen? Snake? Snake! Snaaaaaaaaaaaake!

item.title: World of Warcraft player housing was sorely lacking PvP so Blizzard is dropping its own version of prop hunt
item.content:encoded: Finally, a way to weaponize all those household items.

item.title: Facepunch boss Garry Newman shoots down Rust 2 speculation after mysterious Steam page appears: 'Nope'
item.content:encoded: I thought it might be, but it's not.

item.title: My first campaign in Europa Universalis 5 may have ruined the entire series for me
item.content:encoded: I have 1,700 hours in EU4—now I don't feel like I can go back, but EU5 has to change if I'm going to play it again.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse developers are trying really, really hard to make sure you know it's a metroidvania without using the word 'metroidvania'
item.content:encoded: What is a genre, anyway, but a miserable pile of references.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 is coming this year, and the original is free to keep on Steam if you grab it now
item.content:encoded: The sequel to the 2018 medieval cematary sim launches this year.

item.title: Before Imagine Dragons, brothers Dan and Mac Reynolds always wanted to make videogames—now their first, Last Flag, is about to release
item.content:encoded: They love capture the flag, so they made a game dedicated to flag hiding and flag retrieving, with inspiration from Team Fortress 2, Halo, and League of Legends.

item.title: Survival shooter Road to Vostok 'secured the entire production budget for this game for years and years to come' within 24 hours of its Steam early access launch
item.content:encoded: You could buy a lot of cans of pea soup with that kind of money.

item.title: Gunzilla CEO denies delaying payments to 'full-time official employees,' denies calling unpaid contractors 'haters' (updated)
item.content:encoded: At least one of former Gunzilla staffers who said she went months without being paid sure sounds like a full-time employee, though.

item.title: Wait, how many 'horror Stardew' farm sims are in development right now?
item.content:encoded: We've officially entered an era of anti-cozy farm sims.

item.title: Crimson Desert is now somewhat playable on Intel Arc graphics cards, though Kliff's face didn't make it
item.content:encoded: We managed to get the game to boot with the latest Intel drivers, but I'd hold off for now.

item.title: Over the Hill devs are celebrating reaching 1 million Steam wishlists by giving you a chance to play the Mudrunner-like off-roader early
item.content:encoded: Explore off the beaten track in iconic cars from the '60s to '80s.

item.title: Hope you're hungry 'cause Don't Starve is back with a new co-op survival crafting adventure for Wilson and the gang
item.content:encoded: Did I spot an owlbear?

item.title: One of Steam's most successful Pokémon-likes is doing a Palworld
item.content:encoded: Temtem: Pioneers probably won't have any assault rifles, however.

item.title: Valve rumoured to be working on 'SteamGPT' AI bot for support and anti-cheat functions
item.content:encoded: It definitely won't be anything like GlaDOS...

item.title: Fortnite teases its next collab with Toy Story, but while fans are wondering where Woody is all I want to know is whether we'll be able to play as the aliens
item.content:encoded: The hunt begins for a claw machine.

item.title: If you've ever wondered what it would be like if Vampire Survivors was about driving around a medieval castle on wheels, then surprisingly I've got the perfect roguelike for you
item.content:encoded: Wanderburg mines strategic and satisfying chaos out of one very silly idea.

item.title: The creators of 1000xResist are making a game about convincing an AI she's not a real person
item.content:encoded: No, it's not 2000xResist.

item.title: Research suggests AI infrastructure projects are worth the investment less than 30% of the time
item.content:encoded: Who could have foreseen this?

item.title: Co-op pirate survival game Windrose breaks 1.5 million Steam wishlists, and good news for everyone who's added it to their list: It's coming out next week
item.content:encoded: The coming-very-soon release date was announced during the Triple I showcase.

item.title: Crimson Desert does what other games do backwards and that's why it's a beautiful freak of nature, says imsim vet at Arkane Lyon
item.content:encoded: In most games, for example, your character starts out already knowing what a goat is.

item.title: 'Stardew Valley meets Twin Peaks' in this 'gritty farming thriller,' and if you don't find all of those words appealing I don't know how to help you
item.content:encoded: Grow food and try to solve the mystery of a grim, isolated town in Crop.

item.title: Co-op heist-em-up Thick as Thieves reveals May release date with an all-new gameplay trailer
item.content:encoded: Just a week after devs announced Thick as Thieves will not be a PvPvE game as originally planned, but will instead focus on solo and co-op play.

item.title: Microsoft claims WireGuard and Veracrypt account termination was merely due to not verifying an email: 'Not everything is a conspiracy, sometimes it's literally paperwork'
item.content:encoded: "Not every 'WTF micro$oft' moment is a slam dunk."

item.title: PC shipments have actually grown this quarter despite the RAMpocalypse says IDC. Well, everywhere except the Americas
item.content:encoded: It's probably going to be the only bit of good news for PC vendors this year.

item.title: The best part of Overwatch's latest hero trailer is that it keeps the overarching narrative front and centre, right where it should be
item.content:encoded: Plus, more Emre is always a good thing.

item.title: The Witcher 3 multiplayer mod adds new setting-appropriate features, like the ability to form a totem pole of Geralts or turn into a fox
item.content:encoded: You know, typical Witcher stuff.
